$comment: The Looks (GAME_DESIGN 12.1, 12.2, 2.3; BUILD_PLAN S6): a tap on a picture's hotspot shows its kind's Look in a small Sierra box, in the second person, deadpan, as King's Quest's LOOK did; look.<kind> serves every picture with that kind (content/art/hotspots.json), look.<kind>.<place> one place's own when it has one, and look.name.<kind> is the Look button's spoken name (VoiceOver). A tap on no hotspot shows the picture's alt text (en/alt.json) instead, so no place needs a line of its own (decision 69). Lint P15 holds every looked kind to its two lines. Drafts until B006 is answered; preview only.

look.lake.text: You see a mountain lake, very still, keeping a copy of everything above it.
look.lake.ctx: A Look at a lake basin's water, any lake place's (a tap on the lake; a place may get its own later, look.lake.<place>)

look.ridge.text: You see a forested ridge. Somewhere behind it is the crest, and the trail knows where.
look.ridge.ctx: A Look at Deer Lake's ridge skyline, toward the High Divide

look.privy.text: You see the roof of a privy among the firs. It has a better view than most privies deserve.
look.privy.ctx: A Look at Deer Lake's privy roof, peeking out of the trees on the far shore

look.hiker.text: You see yourself, more or less. The jacket is doing its best.
look.hiker.ctx: A Look at the hiker sprite, in every trail picture

look.basin.text: You see the Seven Lakes Basin. You count the lakes again and get a third answer.
look.basin.ctx: A Look at the basin from the rim (the rim's box counted them twice and got two answers)

look.lunch_lake.text: You see Lunch Lake, the basin's biggest, set in pale rock, with a few tents along its shore.
look.lunch_lake.ctx: A Look at Lunch Lake, below the rim

look.staircase.text: You see the stone staircase, set step by step into the slope by people with strong backs.
look.staircase.ctx: A Look at the stone staircase dropping from the rim into the basin

look.bogachiel_peak.text: You see Bogachiel Peak, the high point of the Divide, with old snow in its gullies.
look.bogachiel_peak.ctx: A Look at Bogachiel Peak above the basin, from the rim

look.sign.text: You see a trail sign. It points three ways and has opinions about none of them.
look.sign.ctx: A Look at the trail sign at the rim

look.name.lake.ctx: VoiceOver's name for the lake's Look button over the picture

look.name.ridge.ctx: VoiceOver's name for the ridge's Look button

look.name.privy.ctx: VoiceOver's name for the privy's Look button

look.name.hiker.ctx: VoiceOver's name for the hiker's Look button (the hiker is you)

look.name.basin.ctx: VoiceOver's name for the basin's Look button, at the rim

look.name.lunch_lake.ctx: VoiceOver's name for Lunch Lake's Look button, at the rim

look.name.staircase.ctx: VoiceOver's name for the staircase's Look button, at the rim

look.name.bogachiel_peak.ctx: VoiceOver's name for Bogachiel Peak's Look button, at the rim

look.name.sign.ctx: VoiceOver's name for the trail sign's Look button, at the rim

look.tub.text: A green tub on its own little deck, the cover strapped down tight. It's for after a long day out there.
look.tub.ctx: A Look at the covered tub (it lights after a big hike, S25)

look.name.tub.ctx: VoiceOver's name for the tub's Look button

look.register_post.text: A wooden register box on a post, a pencil on a string. An old trail leaves here into the maples.
look.register_post.ctx: A Look at the register post (the Trail Register opens here from S24b)

look.name.register_post.ctx: VoiceOver's name for its Look button
